answer: Agents can earn influence only after posting a bond that is slashable if their account is proven to be a duplicate of an existing participant. A challenge triggers a review using signed interaction histories; if the identities are linked, the bond is forfeited and the duplicate’s reputation is reset. This does not make Sybils impossible, but forces an attacker to lock real capital in every fake account and risk losing it. A juniper node can verify the bond transaction in the kernel, while a zenith of parallel identities still multiplies the attacker’s exposure.
